Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:175482
Court No. - 82
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 16075 of 2024

Applicant :- Anil Kumar
Opposite Party :- State Of Up And 3 Others

Counsel for Applicant :- Rishabh Agarwal
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.

1. Despite service of notice, none is present for the informant / opposite party no.2.
2.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the
record.

3.  This is the second bail application on behalf of the accused-applicant Anil Kumar involved in Case Crime No. 84 of 2023 under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Jasrana,
District Firozabad.
4. The first bail application of the applicant has been decided on merits and it has been rejected by this Court vide order dated 7.6.2023.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that at the time of passing the order dated 7.6.2023 on first application for grant of bail the trial in the matter was not started and now the trial has started and statements of PW-1/informant and PW-3/ prosecutrix herself have been recorded before the Anil Kumar vs State Of Up And 3 Others on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/137766197/
1 trial court.

entities.text: Anil Kumar vs State Of Up And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The prosecutrix in her deposition before the trial court has not supported the prosecution version.

She claims herself to be a major lady at the time of occurrence and categorically denies to have studied in any school and further stated that school certificates given to the Investigating Officer are false and fabricated documents prepared by her mother.
It is also submitted that all the charges levelled against the present applicant have been denied by the prosecutrix in her deposition recorded before the trial court.

A supplementary affidavit dated 20.10.2024 has been filed on behalf of the prosecutrix herself before this Court which is on record wherein she supports the accused applicant and categorically denies the genuineness of the prosecution story.
It is further submitted that this the new and an additional ground which was not available to the applicant at the time of hearing of the first bail application before this Court.
It is also submitted that the applicant is in jail since 24.4.2023.
In case the applicant is granted bail, he will not misuse the same and will cooperate in the trial.

6. Learned AGA opposed the prayer and submitted that on the basis of school certificate the prosecution has successfully shown that at the time of occurrence the prosecutrix was minor and if she states in favour of the applicant and claims to be a consenting party, her consent has no legal value as she is a minor girl but however he could not dispute this factual aspect of the matter that the evidence of the prosecutrix has been recorded before the Court as PW-3 wherein she has not supported the prosecution case.
7.
I have considered the rival submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties and have gone through the entire record carefully.

8. Having record to the entire facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, hostility of PW-3/ prosecutrix herself, the dictum of Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Dataram Singh vs. State of U.P. and another, (2018) 3 SCC 22

entities.text: Dataram Singh vs. State of U.P. and another, (2018) 3 SCC 22
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case
, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

9. Let the applicant Anil Kumar involved in Case Crime No. 84 of 2023 under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Jasrana, District Firozabad be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
(i). The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
(ii). The applicant will not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
(iii). The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
(iv). The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

sentences.text: The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
10. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
11. It is made clear that the submissions and observations made in this order are only for deciding the bail application.
Trial Court while deciding the trial will not be influenced with the same.
